Khalin Joshi Leads J&K Open Golf Tournament by Six Shots

Golfer Khalin Joshi has established a six-shot lead in the J&K Open 2026 tournament. He maintained his strong position through the latest rounds of play. The tournament is being held in Jammu and Kashmir.
